title: Oh,oh-oh, we’re losing track of time,
lyrics: Oh,oh-oh, your hand is holding mine.
We’re living in the moment, hearts in a trance,
It's love in the air, it’s a holiday romance!
Oh,oh-oh, this night is ours to keep,
Oh,oh-oh, we’re diving in too deep.
We’re lost in the rhythm, hearts in a trance,
It’s summer forever in our holiday romance!
